description.value: Reel Wrapps is a fast-food flatbread wrap shop in Abbotsford offering globally-inspired fillings — from Thai Chicken and Cajun to West Coast and Kansas City BBQ. Wraps are explicitly marketed as ideal on-the-go meals for parks, beaches, and outdoor settings, making them a natural fit for cyclists. Group Wrapp Platters serving 6–8 people with chips and salsa can be ordered ahead by phone.
